notes.title: Billy Bumbum now available in more languages!
notes.content:
Hey everybody,

You'll now be able to play Billy Bumbum in different languages! You can change the language via the in-game settings.

Supported languages are:

[list]
[*]English
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Italian
[*]German
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hotfix 003
notes.content:
Hey all, here’s another hotfix! Issues tackled:

[list]
[*]Fixed weird block roll behavior in Popotin Valley - 11
[*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]
Cheers,
Jonathan

notes.title: Hotfix 002
notes.content:
Just another little hotfix coming your way. The issues tackled:

[list]
[*] Tweaked the following levels to prevent unintended solutions

[list]
[*] Shiri Springs - 17
[*] Zadek Complex - 19
[*] Zadek Complex - 22
[/list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the ‘Lost & Found’ achievement wouldn’t trigger. If you’ve previously met the requirements for this achievement but didn’t get the achievement due to this bug, simply go to the ‘Friends Screen’ and the achievement should unlock for you.

[*] Additional minor bug fixes
[/list]

Cheers,
Jonathan

notes.title: Hotfix 001
notes.content:
Billy’s very first hotfix, how exciting! 

The issue tackled:

[list]
[*][b]World map loading times have been greatly reduced! [/b]Yay!
[/list]
Thank you all for reporting this issue. Enjoy MORE freedom farts in LESS time!

Cheers,
Jonathan

notes.title: Get hands-on with Billy Bumbum! Now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Start warming up your brain! You'll need it as you solve SO MANY puzzles and save the day as your favorite cube-shaped dragon's butt Billy! Truly a hero of legend. FART FOR FREEDOM!

Billy Bumbum is OUT NOW on Steam. With over 250 thinky puzzles crafted by expert puzzle designers Bumbum will keep you challenged for hours on end. 

We should probably mention that Billy's Bumbum should be your one and only bum!  Stay away from other bums without consent!

notes.title: 🎉 Get Ready for a Fart-tastic Adventure! 🎉
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Billy Bumbum is coming to you on September 7th! Join Billy, the dragon's cube-shaped butt, in a cozy and whimsical puzzle adventure. 

Solve engaging puzzles, and celebrate each victory with a triumphant toot - a heroic act that helps Billy save his friends. 🐉💨

Mark your calendars and prepare to embark on a journey filled with charm, laughter, and brain-teasing fun. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to tickle your brain with Billy Bumbum!

See you on September 7th! 🎮🧩
